AWS Storage Services

AWS 存储服务

Chapters 2 and 3 introduced multiple storage types and solutions. This chapter explores AWS-specific storage services, which map to different kinds of storage solutions present in the market. We’ll start with traditional storage services like block storage and then move to various kinds of databases used to store data identifying business and technical requirements.

第 2 章和第 3 章介绍了多种存储类型和方案。本章探讨 AWS 特有的存储服务，它们对应市场上不同种类的存储方案。我们先从块存储等传统存储服务讲起，然后转向根据业务和技术需求来存储数据的各类数据库。

Referring to our example of Cafe Delhi Heights from Chapter 9, the chain of restaurants is going online where customers can look for available food items and place an order. To provide the best customer experience and food-delivery services online, Cafe Delhi Heights will store data such as restaurant images, menus, marketing campaign information, and so forth on AWS storage services. Cafe Delhi Heights has given us the job of making this happen, so let’s identify their storage requirements and choose the best AWS storage solution. We need to be able to:

回到第 9 章 Cafe Delhi Heights 的例子，这家连锁餐厅正在上线，顾客可以在线查看可用菜品并下单。为了提供最佳客户体验和在线外卖服务，Cafe Delhi Heights 将把餐厅图片、菜单、营销活动信息等数据存储到 AWS 存储服务上。Cafe Delhi Heights 把这件事交给了我们，让我们来识别它们的存储需求并选择最佳 AWS 存储方案。我们需要能够：

  • Store a customer’s profile and access details like username and password
    存储客户的档案以及用户名、密码等访问信息
  • Store food information such as available menu items
    存储食物信息，例如可用的菜单项
  • Store different kinds of media, such as images of food items and reviews uploaded by customers
    存储各类媒体，例如菜品图片和客户上传的评价
  • Perform big data analytics to improve the customer experience, such as separating good and bad reviews
    进行大数据分析以改善客户体验，例如区分好评和差评
  • Create food communities and allow people to interact in social circles
    创建美食社区，让人们在社交圈中互动
  • Search for food items based on multiple identifiers, such as name, restaurant location, and ratings
    基于多个标识搜索菜品，例如名称、餐厅位置和评分
  • Archive application logs and metrics after 90 days and have them persist for a year
    在 90 天后归档应用日志和指标，并保留一年
Page 277

AWS storage services enable customers to store, protect, and analyze data without the worry of any operational overhead. We’ll discuss storage services in two major sections: cloud storage and databases. We’ll start with cloud storage and look at block, file, and object storage services.

AWS 存储服务让客户能够存储、保护和分析数据，而不必担心任何运维开销。我们将分两大部分讨论存储服务：云存储和数据库。我们先从云存储开始，看看块、文件和对象存储服务。

Cloud Storage on AWS

AWS offers multiple options for cloud storage: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) as a block storage service, Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) as a file storage service, and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) as an object storage service. We discussed the general concepts of these storage options in Chapter 2. In this section, we’ll look at the services offered by AWS to support these solutions. Each of these services caters to specific storage requirements, so we’ll examine the benefits each can provide in the following sections.

AWS 提供多种云存储选择：作为块存储服务的 Amazon Elastic Block Store（EBS）、作为文件存储服务的 Amazon Elastic File System（EFS）、以及作为对象存储服务的 Amazon Simple Storage Service（S3）。我们在第 2 章讨论过这些存储选项的一般概念。本节我们看看 AWS 为支持这些方案所提供的服务。这些服务各自针对特定的存储需求，下面各小节将考察它们各自能带来的好处。

Amazon Elastic Block Store

Amazon EBS is a block storage solution that acts like a physical hard drive attached to a personal computer. EBS can be attached to an Amazon EC2 instance (more on EC2 in Chapter 11) with a lifecycle that is independent of the EC2 instance and is flexible in nature, meaning it allows for configuration modification on live production workloads, such as the ability to:

Amazon EBS 是一种块存储方案，就像挂在个人电脑上的物理硬盘。EBS 可以挂载到 Amazon EC2 实例上（EC2 详见第 11 章），其生命周期独立于 EC2 实例，并且非常灵活，意味着它允许在生产负载运行时修改配置，例如能够：

  • Increase size dynamically
    动态扩容
  • Change provisioned input/output operations per second (IOPS) capacity
    更改预置的每秒输入/输出操作数（IOPS）容量
  • Change volume type
    更改卷类型

EBS volumes provide access to data stored on disk with minimum latency and are preferred for use cases requiring frequent disk access, such as:

EBS 卷以极低延迟访问磁盘上存储的数据，适合需要频繁磁盘访问的用例，例如：

  • Creating and maintaining your own database instead of using any services offered by AWS
    自己创建并维护数据库，而不使用 AWS 提供的任何服务
  • Creating OS boot volumes
    创建操作系统引导卷

For use cases that require temporary block storage and better I/O performance than EBS (such as caching, device buffers, etc.), AWS offers another storage solution called an instance store that is directly attached to an instance, unlike EBS, which is network-attached storage. The data in the instance store is wiped out in scenarios such as disk failures and change in the state of an EC2 instance (stop/hibernate/terminate). Instance stores don’t come with the flexibility of EBS volumes, such as attaching to any EC2 instance, dynamic increase in size, and the like.

对于需要临时块存储、且要求比 EBS 更好 I/O 性能的用例（例如缓存、设备缓冲区等），AWS 提供另一种存储方案叫做实例存储（instance store），它直接挂载到实例上，不像 EBS 那样是网络挂载存储。实例存储中的数据在磁盘故障、或 EC2 实例状态变化（停止/休眠/终止）等场景下会被清除。实例存储不具备 EBS 卷那种灵活性，例如挂载到任意 EC2 实例、动态扩容等。

Page 278

AWS offers a wide range of EBS volumes to choose from based on multiple factors, including cost and performance. Let’s look at the scenarios in which to use each kind of volume type:

AWS 提供种类繁多的 EBS 卷，可根据成本、性能等多种因素选择。下面看看每种卷类型适用的场景：

  • Solid-state drives (SSDs). These volume types, including general-purpose SSDs and provisioned-IOPS SSDs, are optimized for transactional workloads. Their major performance attribute is small I/O size.
    固态硬盘（SSD）。这类卷包括通用型 SSD 和预置 IOPS SSD，针对事务型负载优化。它们的主要性能特征是小 I/O 尺寸。
  • Hard disk drives (HDDs). These volume types, including throughput-optimized SSDs and cold HDDs, are optimized for large streaming workloads. Their major performance attribute is throughput.
    机械硬盘（HDD）。这类卷包括吞吐优化型 HDD 和冷 HDD，针对大型流式负载优化。它们的主要性能特征是吞吐量。
  • Magnetic disks. These volume types are mostly suitable for smaller workloads where performance is not a key factor, such as infrequent data access from a storage disk.
    磁性盘。这类卷大多适用于性能不是关键因素的小型负载，例如很少访问存储磁盘上的数据。

Here are few key points about EBS volumes to consider:

关于 EBS 卷，有以下要点：

  • Multiple EBS volumes can be attached to an EC2 instance.
    一台 EC2 实例可以挂载多个 EBS 卷。
  • The scope of the EBS volume is at the AZ level. An EBS volume in us-east-1a can’t be attached to an EC2 instance in us-east-1b. We can create point-in-time snapshots (backups) of EBS volumes to enable replication and ensure high availability across AZs or regions.
    EBS 卷的作用域在 AZ 级别。us-east-1a 中的 EBS 卷不能挂载到 us-east-1b 中的 EC2 实例。我们可以对 EBS 卷创建时间点快照（备份），以实现跨 AZ 或跨区域的复制和高可用。
  • EBS volumes were first launched as nonsharing block storage, meaning an EBS volume can’t be shared among multiple EC2 instances. AWS launched the Multi-Attach EBS volumes feature to allow users to attach a single provisioned-IOPS SSD volume to a max of 16 Nitro-based EC2s in the same AZ for Linux applications.
    EBS 卷最初以不可共享块存储形式推出，意味着一个 EBS 卷不能在多台 EC2 实例间共享。AWS 后来推出 Multi-Attach EBS 卷功能，允许用户把单个预置 IOPS SSD 卷挂载到同一 AZ 中最多 16 台基于 Nitro 的 EC2 上，供 Linux 应用使用。
  • EBS volumes are automatically replicated within an AZ to prevent any data loss.
    EBS 卷在 AZ 内自动复制，以防止数据丢失。

EBS volumes have certain limitations, such as the scope at the AZ level and data sharing across EC2 instances. AWS offers another storage solution, Amazon EFS, to overcome these limitations.

EBS 卷有一些局限，例如作用域在 AZ 级别、以及不能跨 EC2 实例共享数据。AWS 提供另一种存储方案 Amazon EFS 来克服这些局限。

Amazon Elastic File System

EFS is a shared file system that allows storage sharing across multiple servers placed in a region or at an on-premises data center. EFS is a fully managed, serverless solution that supports all AWS compute platforms, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon ECS, and AWS Lambda. There is no need to preconfigure storage space, and pricing is determined based on the storage space you use for your applications.

EFS 是一个共享文件系统，允许跨位于一个区域内、或位于本地数据中心的多台服务器共享存储。EFS 是全托管的无服务器方案，支持所有 AWS 计算平台，例如 Amazon EC2、Amazon ECS 和 AWS Lambda。无需预先配置存储空间，按你为应用使用的存储量计费。

Page 279

Amazon EFS is generally used for business use cases, such as big data analytics, ML workload, and content management. Both the EFS and EBS storage solutions offer low latency for data access, though there are multiple contributing factors in overall performance, such as latency, throughput, and IOPS.

Amazon EFS 通常用于业务场景，例如大数据分析、ML 负载和内容管理。EFS 和 EBS 两种存储方案都提供低延迟的数据访问，不过整体性能受延迟、吞吐量和 IOPS 等多种因素影响。

EFS offers multiple storage classes. You can select a storage class that best fits your business needs:

EFS 提供多种存储类别。你可以选择最符合业务需求的存储类别：

  • EFS Standard and Standard Infrequent Access (Standard IA). Both storage classes provide the highest level of availability across the AZs in an AWS region. EFS Standard is optimal for use cases requiring frequent data access, whereas Standard IA is the better choice for infrequent data access and is a cost-optimal solution. The latency of first byte read or write is higher for the IA storage-class type.
    EFS Standard 与 Standard Infrequent Access（Standard IA）。这两种存储类别都在 AWS 区域内的各 AZ 之间提供最高级别的可用性。EFS Standard 最适合需要频繁访问数据的用例，而 Standard IA 更适合不常访问的数据，是成本最优的方案。IA 存储类别的首字节读写延迟更高。
  • EFS One Zone and One Zone Infrequent Access (One Zone IA). One Zone storage classes differ from Standard storage classes in terms of availability and cost. One Zone ensures high availability within a single AZ, whereas Standard spans the AZs within a region. Because of this, One Zone is relatively cheaper. AWS Backup, which replicates the data across three AZs, can be used for better durability.
    EFS One Zone 与 One Zone Infrequent Access（One Zone IA）。One Zone 存储类别与 Standard 存储类别在可用性和成本上不同。One Zone 在单个 AZ 内确保高可用，而 Standard 跨一个区域内的多个 AZ。因此 One Zone 相对更便宜。可以使用 AWS Backup（把数据跨三个 AZ 复制）来获得更好的持久性。

Cloud is still a relatively new technology for hosting business applications, and there are scenarios where you’ll rely on other filesystems, such as Windows File Server. For such use cases, AWS offers a managed service: Amazon FSx, which scales automatically without any operational overhead. You can leverage FSx to run popular open source and licensed filesystems without the worry of maintenance or hardware setup.

云对于托管业务应用仍是一项相对较新的技术，有些场景你会依赖其他文件系统，例如 Windows File Server。对于这类用例，AWS 提供托管服务 Amazon FSx，它自动扩展、无任何运维开销。你可以利用 FSx 运行流行的开源和授权文件系统，而不必担心维护或硬件搭建。

There are two FSx variants that you can select as needed per your use case:

FSx 有两种变体，可根据用例需要选择：

  • FSx for Windows File Server. This option is built on Windows Server and is accessible over the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol from Windows, Linux, or MacOS to execute use cases such as data deduplication, end-user file store, and Microsoft Active Directory (AD) integration.
    FSx for Windows File Server。该选项构建在 Windows Server 之上，可通过服务器消息块（SMB）协议从 Windows、Linux 或 MacOS 访问，用于实现数据去重、终端用户文件存储、Microsoft Active Directory（AD）集成等用例。
  • FSx for Lustre. Built on a popular high-performance filesystem, Lustre, this option works well for compute-intensive workloads, such as ML, high-performance computing, and video rendering. It can also be linked with Amazon S3, allowing accessing and processing of data concurrently from the filesystem as well as the S3 API.
    FSx for Lustre。该选项构建在流行的高性能文件系统 Lustre 之上，非常适合计算密集型负载，例如 ML、高性能计算和视频渲染。它还可以与 Amazon S3 链接，允许同时从文件系统和 S3 API 访问并处理数据。

Note that a server is required for accessing data from EBS and EFS storage services. S3 is an unlimited storage solution offered by AWS that allows users to directly access the files over the public internet or a private AWS network without requiring a server in between.

请注意，从 EBS 和 EFS 存储服务访问数据需要一台服务器。S3 是 AWS 提供的无限制存储方案，允许用户通过公网或 AWS 私有网络直接访问文件，而中间不需要服务器。

Page 280

Amazon Simple Storage Service

AWS provides Amazon S3 as an unlimited object storage solution. You can use S3 to store and protect data for a wide range of use cases, such as websites, media storage, backups, and big data analytics. S3 stores objects in containers called buckets. Here are some key concepts that will deepen your understanding of how to use S3:

AWS 提供 Amazon S3 作为无限制对象存储方案。你可以用 S3 为各种用例存储和保护数据，例如网站、媒体存储、备份和大数据分析。S3 把对象存储在叫做桶（bucket）的容器中。下面是一些关键概念，能加深你对如何使用 S3 的理解：

  • Bucket. A bucket is a container identified by a unique name. You need to specify the bucket name and AWS region while creating the bucket, along with other options, such as versioning support.
    桶（Bucket）。桶是由唯一名称标识的容器。创建桶时需要指定桶名和 AWS 区域，以及其他选项，例如版本控制支持。
  • Object. An object is a file that is uploaded to a bucket and identified by a key name that is unique across the bucket. An object in a bucket has exactly one key as an identifier.
    对象（Object）。对象是上传到桶中的文件，由在桶内唯一的键名（key）标识。桶中的对象恰好有一个键作为标识符。
  • Versioning. S3 allows you to store multiple versions of the same object. This enables users to access any object version and is useful in scenarios like application failure. A unique version ID is associated with each version of the object.
    版本控制（Versioning）。S3 允许你存储同一对象的多个版本。这让用户可以访问任意对象版本，在应用故障等场景中很有用。对象的每个版本都关联一个唯一的版本 ID。

S3 storage classes. The data-storage pattern can vary from use case to use case; therefore, S3 offers multiple storage classes. You can select a storage class based on business requirements, such as: do we need to access the data frequently, or do we require a data archival store? It’s important to identify your business use case and then choose the S3 storage class that best fits to make the most out of S3 with minimum cost. S3 has three storage classes based on the object’s access type and redundancy.

S3 存储类别。数据存储模式因用例而异；因此 S3 提供多种存储类别。你可以根据业务需求选择存储类别，例如：我们需要频繁访问数据，还是需要一个数据归档存储？重要的是先明确业务用例，再选择最合适的 S3 存储类别，以最低成本充分利用 S3。S3 根据对象的访问类型和冗余度有三种存储类别。

Frequently accessed objects. The storage class for frequently accessed objects is preferred for latency-sensitive (at the millisecond level) use cases. There are two subclasses based on required redundancy support:

频繁访问的对象。频繁访问对象的存储类别适用于延迟敏感（毫秒级）的用例。根据所需的冗余支持，它有两个子类：

  • S3 Standard. The default storage class when a bucket is created.
    S3 Standard。创建桶时的默认存储类别。
  • Reduced redundancy. Can be chosen for noncritical use cases with reduced redundancy compared to S3 Standard.
    降级冗余（Reduced redundancy）。可用于非关键用例，相比 S3 Standard 冗余度更低。

AWS recommends the S3 storage class over reduced redundancy as it is more cost-effective.

AWS 建议使用 S3 存储类别而非降级冗余，因为它更划算。

Page 281

Infrequently accessed objects. The storage class for infrequently accessed objects is preferred for long-lived, infrequently accessed data, such as backups. There are two subclasses based on required redundancy support:

不常访问的对象。不常访问对象的存储类别适用于长期保存、不常访问的数据，例如备份。根据所需冗余支持，它有两个子类：

  • Standard IA. Data is stored redundantly in multiple AZs, so objects are resilient to a loss of AZ.
    Standard IA。数据跨多个 AZ 冗余存储，因此对象能抵御单个 AZ 丢失。
  • One Zone IA. Data is stored in a single AZ, so data is less resilient in comparison to Standard IA, which also makes this subclass relatively cheaper. This storage class is preferred if data loss is not critical for business or if data can be re-created in some way.
    One Zone IA。数据存储在单个 AZ 中，因此相比 Standard IA 持久性较低，这也使该子类相对更便宜。如果数据丢失对业务不关键、或数据可以通过某种方式重建，则首选该存储类别。

Archived objects. The storage class for archived objects provides low-cost data-archiving support with a resiliency like the S3 Standard storage class. There are three subclasses based on data-retrieval needs:

归档对象。归档对象的存储类别提供低成本的数据归档支持，并具有与 S3 Standard 存储类别相当的持久性。根据数据检索需求，它有三个子类：

  • S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. This storage class is useful for rarely accessed data that requires millisecond retrieval. The storage cost is less, and the data-access cost is at the higher end when compared with Standard IA.
    S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。该存储类别适用于很少访问、但需要毫秒级检索的数据。存储成本较低，但与 Standard IA 相比数据访问成本较高。
  • S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. This storage class is useful for data accessibility within minutes (one to five minutes). This subclass requires a minimum storage duration period of 90 days, so even if data is removed or transitioned before that time, the cost will be calculated for the full 90 days.
    S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。该存储类别适用于几分钟（1 到 5 分钟）内可取到数据的场景。该子类要求最短存储时长 90 天，因此即使数据在此之前被删除或转换，费用仍按完整 90 天计算。
  • S3 Glacier Deep Dive. This storage class is the least costly, requires a minimum storage duration of 180 days, and has a default retrieval time of 12 hours. You can also use the bulk-retrieval option, with data being retrieved within 48 hours.
    S3 Glacier Deep Dive。该存储类别成本最低，要求最短存储时长 180 天，默认检索时间 12 小时。你也可以使用批量检索选项，数据在 48 小时内取回。

Lifecycle configurations. Consider a scenario requiring frequent data access for 30 days and infrequent access after that. Such use cases can be satisfied via S3 lifecycle configurations; these configurations are the rules that apply to bucket objects. There are two type of actions that you need to define as part of these configurations:

生命周期配置。考虑这样一个场景：前 30 天需要频繁访问数据，之后不常访问。这类用例可以通过 S3 生命周期配置满足；这些配置就是应用于桶对象的规则。作为这些配置的一部分，你需要定义两类动作：

  • Transition actions. Define object transition to another storage class, such as move object from Standard to Standard IA storage class after 30 days.
    转换动作。定义对象转换到另一个存储类别，例如 30 天后把对象从 Standard 移到 Standard IA 存储类别。
  • Expiration actions. Define object expiration. S3 will delete objects automatically once they are expired per the configured rule.
    过期动作。定义对象过期。一旦对象按配置规则过期，S3 会自动删除它们。
Page 282

Intelligent tiering. S3 optionally provides intelligent-tiering support such that data is automatically moved to different storage classes without any operational overhead. Here is the lifecycle followed by the objects to be moved to different storage classes:

智能分层。S3 可选提供智能分层支持，数据会自动移动到不同存储类别，而无任何运维开销。下面是对象被移动到不同存储类别所遵循的生命周期：

  • Frequent access. Objects uploaded or transitioned to S3 intelligent tiering are stored in the frequent access tier.
    频繁访问。上传或转换到 S3 智能分层的对象，先存储在频繁访问层。
  • Infrequent access. Objects are moved to the infrequent access tier if they are not accessed for 30 consecutive days.
    不频繁访问。如果对象连续 30 天未被访问，就移到不频繁访问层。
  • Archive instant access. Objects are moved to the archive instant access tier if they are not accessed for 90 consecutive days. S3 provides two optional archive access tiers based on the time period of data access. If activated, data is moved to archive access if it is not accessed for a minimum of 90 consecutive days and moved to deep archive access if it is not accessed for a minimum of 180 consecutive days.
    归档即时访问。如果对象连续 90 天未被访问，就移到归档即时访问层。S3 根据数据访问时间段提供两个可选归档访问层。若启用，数据连续至少 90 天未被访问则移到归档访问层，连续至少 180 天未被访问则移到深度归档访问层。

Storage classes store data to S3 based on access patterns or required redundancy support. Another factor to consider is data security while storing objects to S3.

存储类别根据访问模式或所需冗余支持把数据存入 S3。另一个要考虑的因素是把对象存入 S3 时的数据安全。

Amazon S3 data security

Objects in an S3 bucket are by default accessible to the owner of the bucket. S3 provides different mechanisms for securing data and configuring access permissions for the S3 bucket and objects:

S3 桶中的对象默认由桶的所有者访问。S3 提供不同机制来保护数据、并配置 S3 桶和对象的访问权限：

  • Encryption. S3 encrypts all objects by default with server-side encryption (SSE-S3) unless a different encryption option is selected, such as AWS Key Management Service (KMS), referred to as SSE-KMS. You can also configure client-side encryption for more security.
    加密。S3 默认用服务端加密（SSE-S3）加密所有对象，除非选择其他加密选项，例如 AWS Key Management Service（KMS），称为 SSE-KMS。你也可以配置客户端加密以获得更高安全性。
  • Object Lock. Object Lock can be enabled on versioned buckets. Once enabled, objects are stored using a write once, read many (WORM) model, which could be a regulatory requirement for an organization. Object Lock provides an extra protection layer for object changes and helps prevent deleting or overwriting objects for a fixed retention period or indefinitely (referred to as a legal hold).
    对象锁（Object Lock）。对象锁可以在已启用版本控制的桶上开启。一旦开启，对象按一次写入、多次读取（WORM）模型存储，这可能是组织的合规要求。对象锁为对象变更提供额外保护层，有助于在固定保留期内（或无限期，称为法定保留）防止删除或覆盖对象。
  • Block off public access. This option is for setting up and managing centralized control on public access to the bucket. This configuration can also be applied at the account level so that it is reflected for all S3 buckets in the AWS account. In general, it is not a good idea to make a bucket public unless there is a specific business requirement, such as a bucket with publicly accessible media files. You can use Access Analyzer for S3 to identify buckets that grant public access.
    阻止公有访问。该选项用于对桶的公有访问建立和管理集中控制。此配置也可以应用在账户级别，从而对该 AWS 账户中的所有 S3 桶生效。一般来说，把桶设为公有不是好主意，除非有具体业务需求，例如存放可公开访问媒体文件的桶。你可以使用 Access Analyzer for S3 来识别授予了公有访问的桶。
Page 283
  • IAM policies. IAM policies grant users or groups read-write access to S3 resources.
    IAM 策略。IAM 策略授予用户或组对 S3 资源的读写访问权限。
  • Amazon Macie. Amazon Macie identifies and secures sensitive data stored in S3 buckets, such as credit card numbers. It also helps evaluate bucket-level access controls (similar to Access Analyzer), such as publicly accessible buckets.
    Amazon Macie。Amazon Macie 识别并保护存储在 S3 桶中的敏感数据，例如信用卡号。它还有助于评估桶级访问控制（类似 Access Analyzer），例如可公开访问的桶。
  • Access control lists (ACLs). S3 ACLs are attached to an S3 bucket or object as subresources to manage access by other users. ACLs are disabled by default, and it is recommended to keep them that way unless there is a requirement to control the access of each object individually. Instead of ACLs, you can rely on policies for access control.
    访问控制列表（ACL）。S3 ACL 作为子资源挂载到 S3 桶或对象上，用于管理其他用户的访问。ACL 默认禁用，建议保持禁用，除非需要单独控制每个对象的访问。可以用策略而非 ACL 来做访问控制。
  • Bucket policy. Bucket policies manage access permissions to an S3 bucket as well as the objects in it. For example, they can allow account A to read objects from an S3 bucket owned by account B. Bucket policies are limited to 20 KB in size.
    桶策略。桶策略管理对 S3 桶以及桶内对象的访问权限。例如，它们可以允许账户 A 读取账户 B 所拥有的 S3 桶中的对象。桶策略大小限制为 20 KB。

We have covered different services that allow you to store data with cloud storage and process it like storage on a personal computer. Next, we’ll discuss the database services offered by AWS. You should already be familiar with how data is stored in databases from Chapter 2 (relational databases) and Chapter 3 (nonrelational databases).

我们已经介绍了不同的服务，让你能用云存储存储数据，并像在个人电脑上那样处理它。接下来讨论 AWS 提供的数据库服务。你应该已经从第 2 章（关系数据库）和第 3 章（非关系数据库）熟悉了数据在数据库中如何存储。

AWS Databases

AWS offers a range of database services—Amazon RDS, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon DocumentDB, Amazon ElastiCache, and more—to meet customer requirements for different use cases. These services minimize or completely remove any operational overhead of software and hardware management and enable you to gain the needed scale for your organization. We’ll start with the relational database offering, which falls under the umbrella service RDS, with support for Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and Amazon Aurora as database engines.

AWS 提供一系列数据库服务——Amazon RDS、Amazon DynamoDB、Amazon DocumentDB、Amazon ElastiCache 等——以满足不同用例下的客户需求。这些服务最小化或完全免除软件和硬件管理的运维开销，让你为组织获得所需的规模。我们从关系数据库产品讲起，它属于 RDS 这一伞形服务，支持 Oracle、Microsoft SQL Server、MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB 和 Amazon Aurora 作为数据库引擎。

Amazon RDS

Without Amazon RDS, you have a couple of options when you want to run relational database engines like MySQL or PostgreSQL, which were covered in Chapter 2. Should you want to use, for example, a MySQL database engine on your local machine, you’d need to download the installation package and install it. If you’re using AWS cloud computing services, you could install the package on an EC2 machine, but once it’s up and running, you’ll have to take care of maintaining it, attaching EBS volumes, and so on.

如果没有 Amazon RDS，当你想运行第 2 章讲过的 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL 等关系数据库引擎时，会有几个选择。例如，如果你想在本地机器上用 MySQL 数据库引擎，就得下载安装包并安装。如果用 AWS 云计算服务，你可以把安装包装到 EC2 机器上，但一旦它跑起来，你就得操心维护、挂载 EBS 卷等事务。

Page 284

RDS removes all this overhead so that you can just focus on creating a DB instance and start using it with a few clicks. You can follow the steps from the documentation for creating RDS DB instances, but a few details are important to keep in mind when creating a database:

RDS 免去了所有这些开销，你只需专注于创建一个数据库实例，点几下就能开始使用。你可以按文档中的步骤创建 RDS 数据库实例，但创建数据库时有几个细节很重要：

  • Engine type. You can select the database engine that meets your needs. Once you select a specific engine, you are required to specify some additional configurations, such as edition and engine version.
    引擎类型。你可以选择满足需求的数据库引擎。选定特定引擎后，需要指定一些额外配置，例如版本和引擎版本号。
  • Templates. Templates enable you to preselect the setting options while setting up a database. The available templates are production, dev/test, and free tier.
    模板。模板让你在搭建数据库时预选设置选项。可用模板有生产、开发/测试和免费套餐。
  • Settings. Settings include details like DB instance identifier (which is unique across AWS accounts in the region) and credentials settings (username and password).
    设置。设置包括数据库实例标识符（在该区域内 AWS 账户间唯一）和凭据设置（用户名和密码）等细节。
  • DB instance class. The DB instance class determines the computation and memory capacity of an instance. You can select from a list of standard, memory-optimized, and burstable classes, depending on your workload’s processing and memory requirements.
    数据库实例类型。数据库实例类型决定实例的计算和内存容量。你可以根据负载的处理和内存需求，从通用型、内存优化型和突发型实例类型列表中选择。
  • Storage. Storage configurations allow you to select a storage type from SSD, HDD, or magnetic disks, and a storage allocation number with autoscaling enabled or disabled.
    存储。存储配置让你从 SSD、HDD 或磁性盘中选择存储类型，并设置存储分配量、以及是否启用自动扩展。
  • Availability and durability. To ensure high availability of production databases, RDS has multi-AZ deployment options for creating a standby instance in different AZs. This helps overcome any database or AZ failure.
    可用性与持久性。为确保生产数据库的高可用，RDS 有多 AZ 部署选项，可在不同 AZ 创建一个备实例。这有助于克服任何数据库或 AZ 故障。
  • Connectivity. Connectivity configurations allow you to select a VPC DB instance. Additional configurations establish connections with DB instances, including the subnet group, the security group, whether the instance is publicly accessible, the AZ, and the database port.
    连接。连接配置让你选择 VPC 数据库实例。其他配置用于建立与数据库实例的连接，包括子网组、安全组、实例是否可公开访问、AZ 和数据库端口。

In addition to these options, you can configure settings like backups, monitoring, and maintenance windows.

除这些选项外，你还可以配置备份、监控和维护窗口等设置。

Amazon also provides its own proprietary database engine, Aurora, which is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL. Aurora is up to five times faster than MySQL and up to three times faster than PostgreSQL running on the same hardware. It also scales automatically per the application needs. Aurora creates six copies of your data distributed across three AZs and continuously backs it up to S3. Aurora also can replicate data across multiple regions for faster global access. You can use Aurora Serverless for unpredictable workloads or for development purposes when you don’t have a requirement to keep DB instances running all the time.

Amazon 还提供自己的专有数据库引擎 Aurora，它与 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 兼容。在相同硬件上，Aurora 比 MySQL 快最多 5 倍、比 PostgreSQL 快最多 3 倍。它还能根据应用需求自动扩展。Aurora 把你的数据创建为跨三个 AZ 分布的六份副本，并持续备份到 S3。Aurora 还可以跨多个区域复制数据，以实现更快的全球访问。对于不可预测的负载、或不需要数据库实例一直运行的开发场景，你可以使用 Aurora Serverless。

Page 285

Here are few key considerations regarding Aurora:

关于 Aurora，有以下关键考虑：

  • There is no requirement to configure storage requirements as with RDS—this is handled internally by Aurora.
    不像 RDS 那样需要配置存储需求——这由 Aurora 内部处理。
  • Aurora Serverless operates based on minimum and maximum Aurora capacity units and not based on instance types like RDS.
    Aurora Serverless 基于最小和最大 Aurora 容量单位运行，而不像 RDS 那样基于实例类型。
  • RDS works at the VPC level. Classic RDS can be opened to the public internet or restricted to allow specific IPs to access it from the outside. With Aurora Serverless, you can’t provide public access, but you can use the Data API or leverage an EC2 machine in the same VPC as Aurora to facilitate the connectivity.
    RDS 在 VPC 级别工作。经典 RDS 可以向公网开放，或限制为只允许特定 IP 从外部访问。对于 Aurora Serverless，你无法提供公有访问，但可以使用 Data API，或利用与 Aurora 同 VPC 中的 EC2 机器来建立连接。
  • For data security or to meet compliance requirements for data encryption at rest, RDS and Aurora both have the functionality to encrypt DB instances.
    为数据安全或满足静态数据加密的合规要求，RDS 和 Aurora 都具备加密数据库实例的功能。
  • An Aurora DB cluster can consist of up to 15 Aurora replicas. The replicas scale and distribute the read workload to multiple instances, ensuring latency-optimized read operations. The read replica is promoted to the writer instance in case the writer instance goes down, increasing overall availability of the Aurora cluster.
    一个 Aurora 数据库集群最多可包含 15 个 Aurora 副本。这些副本扩展并把读负载分发到多个实例，确保延迟优化的读操作。如果写实例宕机，读副本会被提升为写实例，从而提升 Aurora 集群的整体可用性。

RDS is a beneficial service when your business requirements require support for relational structured data with complete compliance with ACID properties. Many modern applications don’t have a requirement for strong ACID compliance, full relational support, or fixed schema. NoSQL databases are viable solutions to address these kinds of use cases while also providing scalability, high performance, and no operational overhead. We described multiple types of NoSQL databases in Chapter 3. In this chapter, we will cover the equivalent services offered by AWS for different types of NoSQL databases, starting with Amazon DynamoDB as a key-value database solution.

当业务需求要求支持关系型结构化数据、并完全遵守 ACID 特性时，RDS 是一项很有用的服务。许多现代应用并不要求强 ACID 合规、完整的关系支持或固定 schema。NoSQL 数据库是应对这类用例的可行方案，同时还提供可扩展性、高性能和零运维开销。我们在第 3 章描述了多种 NoSQL 数据库。本章将介绍 AWS 为不同类型 NoSQL 数据库提供的等价服务，先从作为键值数据库方案的 Amazon DynamoDB 讲起。

To support unlimited compute and storage scaling in relational databases for transactional workloads, AWS has announced Aurora DSQL. Aurora DSQL is a distributed relational database with PostgreSQL compatibility, ACID compliance, and zero maintenance overhead.
为支持事务型负载在关系数据库中实现无限制的计算和存储扩展，AWS 发布了 Aurora DSQL。Aurora DSQL 是一个分布式关系数据库，兼容 PostgreSQL、遵守 ACID、零维护开销。
Page 286

Amazon DynamoDB

Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value database designed to provide single-digit millisecond latency for any workload scale. DynamoDB stores data in tables and follows a schemaless design. We discussed the primary key, partition key, and sort key in Chapter 3 in the context of using key-value data stores to uniquely identify items. In DynamoDB architecture, the primary key is represented by a partition key or a combination of a partition key and a sort key. Any queries on data can be performed via the AWS CLI, AWS Console, or AWS Software Development Kit (SDK) in your preferred language. DynamoDB is based on the leader-follower nodes model and internally stores the data on storage nodes called partitions.

Amazon DynamoDB 是一种键值数据库，旨在为任意负载规模提供个位数毫秒级延迟。DynamoDB 把数据存储在表中，采用无 schema 设计。我们在第 3 章讨论过主键、分区键和排序键，那是在使用键值数据存储唯一标识条目的语境下。在 DynamoDB 架构中，主键由分区键、或分区键与排序键的组合表示。对数据的任何查询都可以通过 AWS CLI、AWS 控制台或你偏好语言的 AWS 软件开发工具包（SDK）执行。DynamoDB 基于主从节点模型，内部把数据存储在称为分区的存储节点上。

Here are the keys responsible for data storage on DynamoDB:

下面是 DynamoDB 中负责数据存储的键：

  • Partition key. The partition key must be specified when the table is created and is used as an input to the internal hash function to determine a physical partition where data should be stored. A request router (RR) component routes the request to a specific partition, as shown in Figure 10-1. RR is a stateless service that consults with the Partition Metadata Service to determine the partition; then, the request is forwarded to a specific partition. The PUT request is sent to the leader node, while the GET request can be served via the leader or the follower node, depending on the required consistency support.
    分区键。分区键必须在创建表时指定，它作为内部哈希函数的输入，决定数据应存储在哪个物理分区。请求路由（RR）组件把请求路由到特定分区，如图 10-1 所示。RR 是一个无状态服务，它向分区元数据服务查询以确定分区，然后把请求转发到特定分区。PUT 请求被发送到主节点，而 GET 请求可以由主节点或从节点服务，取决于所需的一致性支持。
  • Sort key. The sort key is an optional attribute upon table creation. If it is specified, then the primary key is a combination of the partition key and the sort key; otherwise, it’s just the partition key. The combination of partition key and sort key should be unique for data storage. All items with the same partition key are stored together on the same physical partition in a sorted order by sort-key value. We recommend creating a DynamoDB table with both the partition key and the sort key per the read/write query patterns that will serve the user requests without the need for global secondary indexes (GSIs).
    排序键。排序键是创建表时的可选属性。如果指定了它，主键就是分区键与排序键的组合；否则就只是分区键。分区键与排序键的组合在存储数据时应唯一。所有具有相同分区键的条目按排序键值排序后，一起存储在同一物理分区上。我们建议根据读/写查询模式创建同时带分区键和排序键的 DynamoDB 表，这样就能服务用户请求而无需全局二级索引（GSI）。
Page 287

DynamoDB is a fully managed service. You don’t have to configure any servers or storage space. Instead, you can select from different capacity modes for allowed reads and writes per specific tables. DynamoDB defines reads and writes as read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs), respectively, and pricing is based on consumed RCUs and WCUs, along with required consistency or transaction support.

DynamoDB 是全托管服务。你不必配置任何服务器或存储空间。相反，你可以为特定表选择不同的容量模式来允许读写。DynamoDB 把读和写分别定义为读容量单位（RCU）和写容量单位（WCU），定价基于消耗的 RCU 和 WCU，以及所需的一致性或事务支持。

Let’s understand the available DynamoDB capacity modes:

下面了解 DynamoDB 可用的容量模式：

  • Provisioned. Customers can configure specific RCU and WCU values for tables that are to be supported, and DynamoDB internally manages the resources to support this scale. This is the preferred mode for applications with predictable traffic, when you can easily forecast RCU and WCU requirements.
    预置模式。客户可以为要支持的表配置具体的 RCU 和 WCU 值，DynamoDB 在内部管理资源以支持这一规模。对于流量可预测、能轻松预测 RCU 和 WCU 需求的应用，这是首选模式。
  • Autoscaling. For varying workloads with undeterminable, fixed provisioned capacity, you can use autoscaling mode with lower and upper RCU and WCU limits, and DynamoDB automatically scales up or down based on the traffic.
    自动扩展。对于负载变化、无法确定固定预置容量的情况，你可以使用带 RCU/WCU 上下限的自动扩展模式，DynamoDB 根据流量自动扩缩。
  • On-demand. On-demand is a serverless kind of support where you don’t need to configure RCU and WCU values. DynamoDB manages the scale in the backend, and we as customers don’t have to worry about it. This is the preferred mode for use cases such as tables with unknown workloads or unpredictable application traffic.
    按需模式。按需是一种无服务器式支持，你无需配置 RCU 和 WCU 值。DynamoDB 在后端管理规模，我们作为客户不必操心。这是工作负载未知、或应用流量不可预测等用例的首选模式。

The DynamoDB table might be responsible for serving multiple use cases, and not all of these use cases will be performant just with primary key design. DynamoDB provides index support to speed up queries, which can be created on top of the table as necessary. We can think of a DynamoDB index as a child table that is created by selecting some of the attributes from the main table. DynamoDB supports two types of indexes: local secondary index (LSI) and global secondary index (GSI). The differences between them are listed in Table 10-1.

DynamoDB 表可能要服务多个用例，并非所有用例只靠主键设计都能有良好性能。DynamoDB 提供索引支持来加速查询，可根据需要在表之上创建。我们可以把 DynamoDB 索引想象成一个子表，它通过从主表选择某些属性而创建。DynamoDB 支持两种索引：本地二级索引（LSI）和全局二级索引（GSI）。二者区别列于表 10-1。

Page 288
ParameterLSIGSI
LifecycleThe LSI lifecycle is the same as that of the table. It can only be created or deleted along with table creation and deletion.The GSI lifecycle is independent of the table and can be created or deleted as required.
Primary key schemaThe partition key is the same as the base table with a different sort key.The partition key and the sort key can be different from the base table.
Querying capabilityScoped to the partition as of the base table—hence the term “local”—with an indexed data size limitation of 10 GB.Queries can span the partitions on base table data—hence the term “global”—with no size limitations.
Provisioned capacityLSI shares read/write throughput capacity with the base table.GSI has independent settings for read/write throughput from the base table.
Read consistencyOffers both strong and eventual read consistency.Offers only eventual read consistency.
表 10-1。Amazon DynamoDB 中 LSI 与 GSI 的区别。生命周期：LSI 与表同生命周期，只能随表创建/删除而创建/删除；GSI 生命周期独立于表，可按需创建/删除。主键模式：LSI 分区键与基表相同、排序键不同；GSI 的分区键和排序键都可以与基表不同。查询能力：LSI 限定在基表分区内（故称“本地”），索引数据大小限制 10 GB；GSI 查询可跨基表数据的各分区（故称“全局”），无大小限制。预置容量：LSI 与基表共享读/写吞吐容量；GSI 有独立于基表的读/写吞吐设置。读一致性：LSI 同时提供强一致和最终一致读；GSI 只提供最终一致读。

As we move from traditional relational databases to a wide variety of modern NoSQL databases, one key difference is transaction support. Transaction is inherently available in SQL-like databases but is not supported in all the NoSQL databases. DynamoDB provides transaction support, and we can choose the specific read and write APIs if our use case has a requirement for transactions. Another difference is strong consistency support: DynamoDB provides both eventual and strong consistency support (though GSI only supports eventual consistency), and we can specify the required support type as we access the data.

当我们从传统关系数据库转向种类繁多的现代 NoSQL 数据库时，一个关键区别是事务支持。事务在类 SQL 数据库中与生俱来，但并非所有 NoSQL 数据库都支持。DynamoDB 提供事务支持，如果用例需要事务，我们可以选择特定的读和写 API。另一个区别是强一致性支持：DynamoDB 同时提供最终一致性和强一致性支持（不过 GSI 只支持最终一致性），我们在访问数据时可以指定所需的支持类型。

We discussed identifying physical partitions based on the partition key and different capacity modes, which helps us configure read and write throughput for DynamoDB tables. The throughput values apply on a table as a whole and are equally divided among the partitions being created. The partitions have hard limits for allowing 3,000 RCUs and 1,000 WCUs (or a combination of both) per second, and requests are throttled once this limit is breached. Apart from read and write requests, there is a 10-GB upper limit as allowed storage per partition. You should carefully design the schema with an understanding of the query patterns as well as the DynamoDB architecture in mind to avoid breaching these limits.

我们讨论了基于分区键识别物理分区以及不同容量模式，这帮助我们为 DynamoDB 表配置读写吞吐。吞吐值作用于整张表，并在创建的各分区之间均分。每个分区有硬性限制：每秒允许 3,000 RCU 和 1,000 WCU（或两者组合），一旦超过就会对请求限流。除读写请求外，每个分区允许的存储上限为 10 GB。你应在理解查询模式和 DynamoDB 架构的前提下仔细设计 schema，以避免突破这些限制。

The partition breaching the defined limits is referred to as hot partition (or hot key). A partition key can be categorized as hot if it receives disproportionately high read or write (or both) traffic compared to other partitions. Figuring out query patterns is key to coming up with the best feasible schema design for a DynamoDB table. You can use CloudWatch contributor insights for debugging and identifying existing hot partitions or most accessed items in DynamoDB tables.

突破所定义限制的分区称为热分区（或热点键）。如果某个分区键相比其他分区接收了异常高的读或写（或两者）流量，它就可被归类为热点。弄清查询模式是为 DynamoDB 表设计出最佳可行 schema 的关键。你可以使用 CloudWatch contributor insights 来调试和识别 DynamoDB 表中现有的热分区或访问最多的条目。

Page 289

Let’s discuss a few best practices for partition key design to avoid hot partition issues in DynamoDB:

下面讨论分区键设计的几个最佳实践，以避免 DynamoDB 中的热分区问题：

  • The table schema should be designed with high cardinality of partition keys. This ensures that the data is widespread across the partitions, improving both read and write efficiency.
    表 schema 应设计为分区键具有高基数。这确保数据分散到各分区，同时提升读写效率。
  • DynamoDB APIs (and AWS SDK in general for all AWS services) throw specific exceptions with proper details, and applications can act on these exceptions accordingly. Retry with exponential backoff is one recommended solution if the hot partition issue occurs rarely. For frequent hot partition issues, more detailed analysis should be done to figure out a stable solution.
    DynamoDB API（以及 AWS 所有服务通用的 AWS SDK）会抛出带有详细信息的特定异常，应用可以据此采取相应动作。如果热分区问题很少发生，带指数退避的重试是推荐方案之一。对于频繁出现的热分区问题，应做更详细的分析以找出稳定解决方案。
  • Redesigning a table schema with existing data could be too much work and needs to be considered from different angles, such as migration downtime and application code changes. The following are intermittent solutions—or long term, if the use case allows—for read and write throttling due to hot partitions:
    在已有数据的情况下重新设计表 schema 工作量可能太大，需要从多个角度考虑，例如迁移停机时间和应用代码改动。下面是因热分区导致读写限流的一些临时方案——如果用例允许，也可作为长期方案：
  • For reads, a cache (discussed in “Amazon ElastiCache”) is a recommended solution. The cache can improve the latency and resolve the hot partition issue.
    对于读，推荐使用缓存（见“Amazon ElastiCache”一节）。缓存可以改善延迟并解决热分区问题。
  • For writes, the solution is to attach a random (or calculated based on logic) suffix to a partition key, such as a number from 1 to 100. The read query will require additional application logic to figure out the actual partition (access all the partitions from 1 to 100 in the case of random logic or a specific partition if the suffix is based on some logic).
    对于写，解决方案是给分区键附加一个随机（或按逻辑计算的）后缀，例如 1 到 100 的数字。读查询将需要额外的应用逻辑来找出实际分区（随机逻辑时访问 1 到 100 的所有分区；若后缀基于某种逻辑，则访问特定分区）。

Evaluate data-access patterns to make best use of DynamoDB at a lower cost and zero operational burden.

评估数据访问模式，以更低成本、零运维负担充分利用 DynamoDB。

Amazon DocumentDB

Amazon DocumentDB is a document database offered by AWS designed to store and query data as JSON-like documents. A document is structured as a collection of nested key-value pairs and can be useful in scenarios like storing food-item information, such as for Cafe Delhi Heights’s online store. Here is a sample document for a customer order:

Amazon DocumentDB 是 AWS 提供的文档数据库，设计为以类 JSON 文档的形式存储和查询数据。文档结构为嵌套键值对的集合，在存储菜品信息等场景中很有用，例如 Cafe Delhi Heights 的在线商店。下面是一个客户订单的示例文档：

{
  "Name": "Mandeep Singh",
  "orderId": "1234-1234-4567",
  "FoodItems": [
    {
      "itemName": "Biryani",
      "qty": 1
    },
    {
      "itemName": "Nuggets",
      "qty": 2
    }
  ]
}

We can add attributes to the food items or remove them without worrying about the fixed schema, as in relational databases. Some other business use cases include content management, real-time big data, and user-profile maintenance. For reference, Table 10-2 compares the terminology associated with DocumentDB with that of relational databases.

我们可以给菜品添加或移除属性，而不必像关系数据库那样担心固定 schema。其他一些业务用例包括内容管理、实时大数据和用户档案维护。作为参考，表 10-2 对比了 DocumentDB 与关系数据库的术语。

SQLAmazon DocumentDB
TableCollection
RowDocument

Primary keyObject ID
表 10-2。SQL 与 Amazon DocumentDB 术语对照。表（Table）对应集合（Collection）；行（Row）对应文档（Document）；列（Column）对应字段（Field）；主键（Primary key）对应对象 ID（Object ID）。

DocumentDB is compatible with MongoDB, with support for powerful ad hoc queries, and it comes with transaction support similar to DynamoDB’s. There are a few functional benefits of DocumentDB over MongoDB, such as transaction support for all CRUD statements, including operations on multiple documents. For all functional differences between MongoDB and DocumentDB, refer to the AWS documentation.

DocumentDB 与 MongoDB 兼容，支持强大的即席查询，并带有类似 DynamoDB 的事务支持。相比 MongoDB，DocumentDB 有一些功能上的好处，例如对所有 CRUD 语句（包括对多个文档的操作）都支持事务。MongoDB 与 DocumentDB 的所有功能差异，请参阅 AWS 文档。

Unlike with DynamoDB, we need to specify the instance class and number of instances for DocumentDB cluster setup. For production systems, we recommend choosing at least three instances for higher availability. The final step is to set up a username and password for authentication and to establish a connection with a DocumentDB cluster.

与 DynamoDB 不同，搭建 DocumentDB 集群时需要指定实例类型和实例数量。对于生产系统，我们建议至少选择三个实例以获得更高可用性。最后一步是设置用户名和密码用于认证，并与 DocumentDB 集群建立连接。

AWS also provides migration tools such as Database Migration Service (DMS) to facilitate easier migration of MongoDB workloads from on-premises or EC2 servers to DocumentDB.

AWS 还提供 Database Migration Service（DMS）等迁移工具，以便更轻松地把 MongoDB 负载从本地或 EC2 服务器迁移到 DocumentDB。

Amazon Neptune

Going back to our Cafe Delhi Heights scenario, one of the requirements for launching an online restaurant is to create food communities for the customers that allow for tracking things like customers’ likes and dislikes of particular food items. Suppose you want to figure out if a food item is liked by everyone in your community, for example.

回到 Cafe Delhi Heights 的场景，上线在线餐厅的需求之一是为客户创建美食社区，以便跟踪客户对特定菜品的喜恶。例如，假设你想知道某道菜是不是社区里人人都喜欢。

Page 291

These kinds of use cases with highly connected data can be stored and queried at scale with AWS’s fully managed graph database service, Amazon Neptune. Neptune is optimized to store and map billions of relationships and enable real-time navigation of connections with a millisecond query response time via Apache TinkerPop Gremlin or openCypher for property graph databases and SPARQL for graph databases in Resource Description Framework (RDF) format. AWS recommends consulting the GitHub repository AWS Reference Architectures for Using Graph Databases to look into graph data models and use cases, query languages, and sample examples of deployment architectures.

这类高度连接数据的用例，可以用 AWS 全托管图数据库服务 Amazon Neptune 大规模地存储和查询。Neptune 经过优化，可存储和映射数十亿关系，并通过 Apache TinkerPop Gremlin 或 openCypher（用于属性图数据库）以及 SPARQL（用于资源描述框架 RDF 格式的图数据库），以毫秒级查询响应时间实时导航连接。AWS 建议参考 GitHub 仓库“AWS Reference Architectures for Using Graph Databases”，了解图数据模型与用例、查询语言和部署架构示例。

Another example use case for Neptune is to get a clear picture of your cloud infrastructure to see how different services or entities are connected to one another. You may want to know which entities use a particular IAM role, as shown in Figure 10-2, or figure out overpermissive IAM policies with * marked on resource permissions. For example, you may not want all the users in the organization to be able to modify network security groups.

Neptune 的另一个用例是清晰了解你的云基础设施，看看不同服务或实体如何相互连接。你可能想知道哪些实体使用了某个特定 IAM 角色，如图 10-2 所示；或找出在资源权限上标记了 * 的过度宽松 IAM 策略。例如，你可能不希望组织里所有用户都能修改网络安全组。

For a step-by-step guide to cluster setup, refer to the AWS documentation. Now, we’ll discuss some points you should be aware of while setting up your graph database cluster.

集群搭建的分步指南请参阅 AWS 文档。下面讨论搭建图数据库集群时需要注意的几点。

Page 292

Compute

The Neptune cluster is launched with a specific instance type that should be selected at the time of creating the cluster. The cluster can have a maximum of one writer instance and up to 15 read replicas; note that writer instances scale vertically, whereas read instances can scale vertically or horizontally. We recommend configuring at least one read replica for higher application availability and better read performance. If a writer instance goes down, the read replica is promoted to writer, and the writer is restarted as a read replica. In case there is only a single writer instance in a cluster, the cluster might be down for a few minutes as it restarts and comes back online.

Neptune 集群以特定实例类型启动，该类型应在创建集群时选择。一个集群最多可有一个写实例和最多 15 个读副本；注意写实例只能垂直扩展，而读实例可以垂直或水平扩展。我们建议至少配置一个读副本，以获得更高应用可用性和更好读性能。如果写实例宕机，读副本会被提升为写实例，原写实例作为读副本重启。如果集群中只有单个写实例，集群可能会在重启并恢复在线的几分钟内不可用。

Neptune also offers a serverless configuration, which can be useful for variable workloads. We can specify an upper capacity limit, and it is used only if needed.

Neptune 还提供无服务器配置，对变化的负载很有用。我们可以指定一个容量上限，仅在需要时才使用。

Storage

Neptune stores data six times across three AZs. Neptune’s storage layer is independent of the compute layers and scales independently and automatically as necessary. It starts with 10 GB and grows up to 128 TB as data increases.

Neptune 把数据跨三个 AZ 存储六份。Neptune 的存储层独立于计算层，并按需独立自动扩展。它从 10 GB 起步，随数据增长最大可达 128 TB。

Traffic distribution

Neptune provides separate writer and reader endpoints. The writer endpoint (called the cluster endpoint) points to the primary instance and should be used for write operations and, optionally, read queries. The reader endpoint distributes requests across the read replicas in round-robin fashion and should be used for all read queries. Neptune also provides an instance endpoint (an endpoint that connects to a specific DB instance) and a custom endpoint that can be used to represent a set of DB instances. Neptune doesn’t offer load balancing functionality on instances. For any such requirement, it should be built into the application code.

Neptune 提供独立的写端点和读端点。写端点（称为集群端点）指向主实例，应用于写操作，也可选地用于读查询。读端点以轮询方式把请求分发到各读副本，应用于所有读查询。Neptune 还提供实例端点（连接到特定数据库实例的端点）和一个可用于代表一组数据库实例的自定义端点。Neptune 不在实例上提供负载均衡功能。有此类需求时，应在应用代码中实现。

Caching

Neptune offers three types of caching support to improve performance:

Neptune 提供三种缓存支持来提升性能：

  • Buffer cache. In-memory cache to improve query performance. Neptune allocates two-thirds of memory of instance to cache.
    缓冲区缓存。用于提升查询性能的内存缓存。Neptune 把实例内存的三分之二分配给缓存。
  • Lookup cache. An instance-level cache for improving read performance for queries with repetitive lookup of property values or RDF literals. It is enabled by default for R5d instances (purpose built for workloads processing large workloads in memory) and uses the instance’s NVM Express-based (NVMe-based) SSD to store these values for quick access.
    查找缓存。一种实例级缓存，用于改善那些重复查找属性值或 RDF 字面量的查询的读性能。它对 R5d 实例（专为在内存中处理大负载而构建）默认启用，并使用实例基于 NVM Express（NVMe）的 SSD 来存储这些值以便快速访问。
Page 293
  • Query results cache. Gremlin read-only query results can be cached to get faster responses upon query rerun. For clearing the cache, you can specify TTL for queries, clear the cache at query level, or clear the entire cache.
    查询结果缓存。Gremlin 只读查询的结果可以缓存，以便再次运行查询时获得更快响应。要清除缓存，可以为查询指定 TTL、在查询级别清除缓存、或清除整个缓存。

Amazon ElastiCache

In-memory databases are extensively used as caching solutions to improve system performance. Amazon ElastiCache is a managed service offered by AWS as a distributed cache environment that works with the Redis and Memcached engines, both covered in detail in Chapter 4. Redis and Memcached are in-memory, key-value caching solutions, but there are associated differences, and it’s important to figure out which caching engine meets your business requirements. Memcached is a simple key-value caching solution to offload reads from a primary data source with multithreading support. Redis comes with functionalities such as persistence for long-lived data, advanced data types like lists and sets, sorting and ranking datasets in memory, geospatial support, message broker, and more. The following are some key considerations for each of the caching engines available as part of ElastiCache.

内存数据库被广泛用作缓存方案以提升系统性能。Amazon ElastiCache 是 AWS 提供的托管服务，作为分布式缓存环境，支持 Redis 和 Memcached 引擎，二者都在第 4 章详细讲过。Redis 和 Memcached 都是内存键值缓存方案，但各有差异，弄清哪种缓存引擎符合业务需求很重要。Memcached 是一种简单的键值缓存方案，通过多线程支持来把读请求从主数据源卸载下来。Redis 则带持久化长驻数据、列表和集合等高级数据类型、在内存中对数据集排序和排名、地理空间支持、消息代理等功能。下面是 ElastiCache 中两种缓存引擎的一些关键考虑。

  • Subnet. As noted in Chapter 9, the number of IP addresses available for use are based on subnet CIDR. As a first step in cluster creation, you should create a subnet associated with Amazon VPC with support available for the required number of IP addresses as they are assigned to nodes in the cluster.
    子网。如第 9 章所述，可用 IP 地址数量取决于子网 CIDR。作为创建集群的第一步，你应创建一个与 Amazon VPC 关联的子网，使其支持所需数量的 IP 地址，因为这些 IP 会分配给集群中的节点。
  • Data tiering. Data can be tiered between memory and NVMe SSD storage for optimizing costs and is ideal for applications that regularly access up to 20% data. This support is available with ElastiCache for Redis for the R6gd instance family, and infrequent data is moved to SSD asynchronously once memory (DRAM) is fully utilized, as shown in Figure 10-3. The storage can scale up to 1 PB in a single cluster.
    数据分层。数据可以在内存和 NVMe SSD 存储之间分层以优化成本，非常适合常规访问不超过 20% 数据的应用。ElastiCache for Redis 的 R6gd 实例系列提供这种支持，一旦内存（DRAM）被占满，不常访问的数据就被异步移到 SSD，如图 10-3 所示。单个集群的存储可扩展到 1 PB。

Both Redis and Memcached can be scaled horizontally and vertically. Redis works on the concept of primary node and read replicas and can be launched with two kinds of configurations:

Redis 和 Memcached 都可以水平和垂直扩展。Redis 基于主节点和读副本的概念工作，可以用两种配置启动：

  • Cluster mode disabled. There can be a maximum of one primary node and up to five replica nodes. This configuration scales horizontally for reads and vertically for writes.
    集群模式禁用。最多一个主节点、最多五个副本节点。这种配置在读上水平扩展、在写上垂直扩展。
  • Cluster mode enabled. There can be a maximum of 500 nodes and up to 5 replicas associated with each node.
    集群模式启用。最多 500 个节点，每个节点最多关联 5 个副本。
Page 294
  • Redundancy and replication. ElastiCache for Redis has multi-AZ deployment support similar to RDS. Whenever a primary node is down, a read replica (one to five read replicas placed in different AZs) is promoted to primary, which ensures high availability even if the entire AZ is down. The replication of data on read replicas also ensures separation of read and write workload.
    冗余与复制。ElastiCache for Redis 有类似 RDS 的多 AZ 部署支持。每当主节点宕机，一个读副本（放置在不同 AZ 的 1 到 5 个读副本中的一个）被提升为主，即使整个 AZ 宕机也能确保高可用。读副本上的数据复制还确保了读负载和写负载分离。
  • Multithreading. Redis is a single-threaded process when incoming requests are handled sequentially, while Memcached is multithreaded, meaning it makes good use of larger Amazon EC2 instance sizes with multiple cores.
    多线程。Redis 处理入站请求时是单线程顺序处理，而 Memcached 是多线程的，意味着它能很好地利用多核的更大 Amazon EC2 实例规格。
  • Persistence. Redis can be used as a standalone database for applications since it supports persistence for long-lived data. Memcached is a pure caching solution that should be used in front of any database, such as RDS, to improve read performance.
    持久化。Redis 因为支持长驻数据持久化，可以作为应用的独立数据库使用。Memcached 是纯缓存方案，应放在任何数据库（如 RDS）之前以提升读性能。
  • Encryption and compliance. Redis supports Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements as well as encryption capabilities. Memcached doesn’t have strong support for authentication and encryption, so the recommendation is to launch Memcached nodes in private subnets with no public connectivity to ensure higher security.
    加密与合规。Redis 支持支付卡行业数据安全标准（PCI DSS）、健康保险流通与责任法案（HIPAA）和联邦风险与授权管理计划（FedRAMP）等要求，并具备加密能力。Memcached 对认证和加密支持不强，因此建议把 Memcached 节点部署在没有公网连接的私有子网中，以确保更高安全性。

For a step-by-step guide to cluster creation, follow the AWS page for Redis and Memcached.

集群创建的分步指南请参考 AWS 上 Redis 和 Memcached 的文档页。

Page 295

Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator

As discussed, you can use Memcached or Redis to offload your database read queries, such as RDS or DynamoDB. DynamoDB offers a custom in-memory cache offering as well, DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX), to improve read performance. DAX is a cluster of primary node and read replicas that run inside VPC, as shown in Figure 10-4. To access DAX, a DAX client is installed alongside an application on the server that directs the application’s DynamoDB API requests to the DAX cluster.

如前所述，你可以用 Memcached 或 Redis 把数据库读查询从 RDS 或 DynamoDB 上卸载下来。DynamoDB 还提供一种定制的内存缓存产品——DynamoDB Accelerator（DAX）——来提升读性能。DAX 是由主节点和读副本组成、运行在 VPC 内的集群，如图 10-4 所示。要访问 DAX，需在服务器上与应用一起安装 DAX 客户端，它把应用的 DynamoDB API 请求导向 DAX 集群。

Here is how read and write APIs execute in the presence of both the DAX cluster and DynamoDB:

在同时存在 DAX 集群和 DynamoDB 时，读写 API 这样执行：

  • Read APIs. The eventually consistent read API calls (GetItem, BatchGetItem, Query, and Scan) are served from DAX. In the scenario of cache miss, the request is passed to DynamoDB to retrieve the response. As DynamoDB returns the result, it also writes the result to the DAX cache on the primary node.
    读 API。最终一致的读 API 调用（GetItem、BatchGetItem、Query 和 Scan）由 DAX 服务。在缓存未命中的情况下，请求被传给 DynamoDB 取回响应。当 DynamoDB 返回结果时，它也把结果写到主节点上的 DAX 缓存。
  • Write APIs. For the write API calls (BatchWriteItem, UpdateItem, DeleteItem, and PutItem), data is first written to the DynamoDB table and then to the DAX cluster. The API returns success only if the write is successful on both DynamoDB and DAX.
    写 API。对于写 API 调用（BatchWriteItem、UpdateItem、DeleteItem 和 PutItem），数据先写入 DynamoDB 表，再写入 DAX 集群。只有在 DynamoDB 和 DAX 上都写入成功，API 才返回成功。

Amazon OpenSearch

You may want to display search results to users based on the user’s search query; in the example of Cafe Delhi Heights, these search results could be a food item, restaurant location, or any supported filters. A search for a food item should return all the restaurant locations serving that item, and a search for a restaurant location should display all dishes served by that location. How can such data be modeled in a database for faster retrieval? For these kinds of business use cases, AWS offers a search database, OpenSearch.

你可能想根据用户的搜索查询向用户展示搜索结果；在 Cafe Delhi Heights 的例子中，这些搜索结果可以是某道菜、某个餐厅位置、或任何支持的筛选条件。搜索一道菜应返回供应这道菜的所有餐厅位置，搜索某个餐厅位置应展示该位置供应的所有菜品。如何在数据库中对这类数据建模以实现更快检索？对于这类业务用例，AWS 提供了一个搜索数据库 OpenSearch。

Page 296

OpenSearch is an open source project derived from Elasticsearch, unlike most of the AWS services, which run on proprietary software. OpenSearch is popular for use cases like full-text search, logs and analytics, ingestion pipelines, and ML. AWS provides OpenSearch dashboards on top of the search engine, which help visualize the data. Here are a few key considerations for the OpenSearch architecture and how we as customers can get the best out of it:

OpenSearch 是从 Elasticsearch 衍生的开源项目，这与大多数运行在专有软件上的 AWS 服务不同。OpenSearch 在全文搜索、日志与分析、摄取管道和 ML 等用例中很受欢迎。AWS 在搜索引擎之上提供 OpenSearch 仪表板，帮助可视化数据。下面是关于 OpenSearch 架构、以及我们作为客户如何充分利用它的几个关键考虑：

  • Cluster setup. OpenSearch can work as a single-node or multinode cluster. As this is an open source project, you can also set up your own cluster following these steps. OpenSearch is a managed service that helps you avoid the operational overhead of setup and works on instance-based (cluster manager and data nodes) or serverless mode. AWS recommends setting up an odd number of cluster manager nodes for a production OpenSearch cluster, with a minimum of three nodes. The type of cluster manager node can be decided based on the number of data nodes in your domain, such as setting up m5.large.search or m6g.large.search for a count of 1−10 data nodes. You can skip setting up dedicated cluster manager nodes for development use cases to save costs (one of the data nodes holds cluster manager–node responsibilities), though it is recommended to configure them for production scenarios for better cluster stability and dedicated nodes for cluster management tasks.
    集群搭建。OpenSearch 可以作为单节点或多节点集群工作。由于它是开源项目，你也可以按这些步骤自己搭建集群。OpenSearch 是托管服务，帮你免去搭建的运维开销，并以基于实例（集群管理器节点和数据节点）或无服务器模式运行。AWS 建议生产 OpenSearch 集群设置奇数个集群管理器节点，最少三个。集群管理器节点的类型可根据域中数据节点数量决定，例如 1 到 10 个数据节点时设置 m5.large.search 或 m6g.large.search。开发用例可以跳过专用集群管理器节点以节省成本（由某个数据节点承担集群管理器职责），但生产场景建议配置它们，以获得更好的集群稳定性和专门用于集群管理任务的节点。
  • Storage. You can select either EBS or instance store volumes to be associated with the instances; the volume types available will depend on the chosen instance type.
    存储。你可以选择 EBS 或实例存储卷关联到实例；可用卷类型取决于所选实例类型。
  • Cluster access. For cluster access and networking, you can choose either VPC access or public access. VPC access allows you to operate the cluster inside your VPC as well as to configure subnets, security groups, and IAM roles.
    集群访问。对于集群访问和联网，你可以选择 VPC 访问或公有访问。VPC 访问让你在 VPC 内运行集群，并配置子网、安全组和 IAM 角色。
  • Deployment. OpenSearch enables configuration updates, such as increasing EBS storage space or upgrading the instance type on a live-running cluster. The configurations are deployed to a new cluster via blue/green deployment to avoid any impact. Perform any such updates during off-peak hours.
    部署。OpenSearch 支持在运行中的集群上做配置更新，例如增大 EBS 存储空间或升级实例类型。这些配置通过蓝/绿部署发布到新集群以避免影响。请在非高峰时段进行此类更新。
  • Dashboard authentication. OpenSearch provides the option to configure authentication for dashboards via Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) authentication or Amazon Cognito authentication.
    仪表板认证。OpenSearch 提供通过安全断言标记语言（SAML）认证或 Amazon Cognito 认证来配置仪表板认证的选项。
Page 297

Amazon Timestream

Amazon Timestream is a fully managed, serverless database service offered for use cases that require time-series data operations, such as DevOps analysis data. Timestream automatically scales to handle trillions of events per day with one-tenth the cost and is up to one thousand times faster than relational databases.

Amazon Timestream 是全托管无服务器数据库服务，面向需要时序数据操作的用例，例如 DevOps 分析数据。Timestream 自动扩展，每天处理数万亿事件，成本仅为十分之一，速度比关系数据库快最多一千倍。

Here are few points to consider for Timestream:

关于 Timestream，有以下几点：

  • As Timestream is serverless, it is easy to use with no requirement for analyzing number or type of instances.
    由于 Timestream 是无服务器的，它很易用，无需分析实例数量或类型。
  • Timestream provides built-in analytics support with interpolation and smoothing functions for identifying trends, patterns, and anomalies using standard SQL.
    Timestream 提供内置分析支持，带插值和平滑函数，用标准 SQL 识别趋势、模式和异常。
  • Data is encrypted by default with a standard key or a customer-owned KMS key.
    数据默认用标准密钥或客户自有的 KMS 密钥加密。
  • Timestream provides support for data-retention policies based on a configured time and for moving data to different storage tiers per policy. It supports two storage tiers: in-memory tier (preferred for latency-sensitive queries) and magnetic disk tier (preferred for analytical queries).
    Timestream 支持基于配置时间的数据保留策略，并按策略把数据移到不同存储层。它支持两个存储层：内存层（适合延迟敏感查询）和磁盘层（适合分析查询）。
  • Records require timestamps as a mandatory dimension, and data stored to Timestream cannot be deleted or updated. Removal of data should be handled via configuration of retention policies.
    记录要求把时间戳作为必需维度，存入 Timestream 的数据不能删除或更新。数据移除应通过配置保留策略来处理。

Amazon Keyspaces

We discussed wide-column databases in Chapter 3 and then looked at an open source variant, Apache Cassandra. The AWS-managed solution to meet similar requirements is Amazon Keyspaces.

我们在第 3 章讨论了宽列数据库，然后看了开源变体 Apache Cassandra。AWS 满足类似需求的托管方案是 Amazon Keyspaces。

Keyspaces is a highly scalable, available, and managed wide-column database service compatible with the open source Apache Cassandra database. Keyspaces is offered as a serverless service, meaning you don’t have to worry about resource provisioning and can simply focus on building your applications. Here a few use cases for which to consider using Keyspaces:

Keyspaces 是高度可扩展、高可用的托管宽列数据库服务，兼容开源 Apache Cassandra 数据库。Keyspaces 以无服务器服务形式提供，意味着你不必操心资源开通，只需专注构建应用。下面是一些可考虑使用 Keyspaces 的用例：

  • You want to migrate on-premises Cassandra clusters or clusters running on EC2 instances to a fully managed AWS service. This helps reduce large cluster management overhead, such as managing deployment, figuring out best configurations for your workload like Java virtual machine (JVM) tuning for garbage collection, understanding Cassandra internals, provisioning capacity for expected workloads, upgrading to newer versions, patching and maintaining cluster infrastructure, and so on.
    你想把本地 Cassandra 集群或运行在 EC2 实例上的集群迁移到全托管 AWS 服务。这有助于减少庞大的集群管理开销，例如管理部署、为你的负载确定最佳配置（如为垃圾回收做 Java 虚拟机 JVM 调优）、理解 Cassandra 内部机制、为预期负载预置容量、升级到更新版本、打补丁和维护集群基础设施等。
  • You have a business requirement to be compatible with open source Cassandra.
    你的业务要求与开源 Cassandra 兼容。
Page 298
  • Keyspaces has better integration with AWS services like Amazon CloudWatch for monitoring purposes or AWS IAM for authentication, compared to customers managing them on their own.
    相比客户自行管理，Keyspaces 与 Amazon CloudWatch（监控）、AWS IAM（认证）等 AWS 服务集成更好。

Since Keyspaces abstracts out infrastructure management, you don’t have access to low-level cluster management control plane APIs. Keyspaces offers two types of capacity modes for tables’ read and write workloads similar to DynamoDB: provisioned capacity with autoscaling and on demand. All the data in Keyspaces tables is by default encrypted and replicated in multiple AZs for high availability and durability. Refer to the AWS guide for the functional differences between Cassandra and Keyspaces.

由于 Keyspaces 把基础设施管理抽象掉了，你无法访问底层集群管理控制平面 API。Keyspaces 像 DynamoDB 一样，为表的读写负载提供两种容量模式：带自动扩展的预置容量和按需容量。Keyspaces 表中的所有数据默认加密，并跨多个 AZ 复制以实现高可用和持久性。Cassandra 与 Keyspaces 的功能差异请参阅 AWS 指南。

Conclusion

We discussed a wide range of storage services offered by AWS that can be used to fulfill your business needs. “Cloud Storage on AWS” focused on primitive storage options, such as block storage, file storage, and object storage, and “AWS Databases” covered AWS services offered for relational and nonrelational databases. It’s quite important to understand the business use case for choosing the best cost-optimal storage service. To that end, let’s take another look at our Cafe Delhi Heights storage requirements. Table 10-3 lists which AWS storage services can be used to fulfill these requirements.

我们讨论了 AWS 提供的、可用于满足业务需求的广泛存储服务。“AWS 上的云存储”聚焦于块存储、文件存储和对象存储等基础存储选项，“AWS 数据库”则介绍了 AWS 为关系和非关系数据库提供的服务。理解业务用例对于选择成本最优的存储服务非常重要。为此，让我们再看一眼 Cafe Delhi Heights 的存储需求。表 10-3 列出了可用哪些 AWS 存储服务来满足这些需求。

RequirementStorage service
Store customer’s profile and access details, such as username and passwordAmazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon ElastiCache as cache on top of persistent store for frequent queries
Store food information, such as available menu itemsAmazon DynamoDB, Amazon DocumentDB, Amazon Keyspaces, Amazon OpenSearch
Store different kinds of media, such as images of restaurant food items and customer-uploaded reviewsAmazon S3
Big data analytics to improve the customer experience, such as separating good and bad reviewsAmazon S3, Amazon EFS, Amazon DynamoDB
Create food communities and allow people to interact in social circlesAmazon Neptune
Search for food items based on multiple identifiers, such as food name, restaurant location, ratings, etc.Amazon OpenSearch
Application logs and metrics archival after 90 days and persistence for one yearAmazon S3, Amazon OpenSearch
表 10-3。Cafe Delhi Heights 的存储服务选型。存储客户档案及用户名密码等访问详情：Amazon RDS、Amazon Aurora，并在持久存储之上用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存高频查询。存储菜品信息（如可用菜单项）：Amazon DynamoDB、Amazon DocumentDB、Amazon Keyspaces、Amazon OpenSearch。存储各类媒体（如菜品图片、客户上传评价）：Amazon S3。做大数据分析改善客户体验（如区分好评差评）：Amazon S3、Amazon EFS、Amazon DynamoDB。创建美食社区、让人们社交互动：Amazon Neptune。按菜名、餐厅位置、评分等多标识搜索菜品：Amazon OpenSearch。90 天后归档应用日志和指标并保留一年：Amazon S3、Amazon OpenSearch。
